description_for_human: Query NovaPay GRC projects, controls, and the CISO Copilot chat API.
description_for_model: Use these actions to read GRC projects and controls, check agent status, and ask the grounded CISO Copilot chat endpoint. Prefer chat for narrative answers; use list endpoints for structured inventories.

functions.name: getHealth
functions.description: Check whether the GRC API is healthy.

functions.name: listProjects
functions.description: List GRC compliance projects the caller can access.

functions.name: listControls
functions.description: List master GRC controls from the controls repository.

functions.name: listProjectControls
functions.description: List controls for a specific project including status and evidence metadata.

functions.name: copilotChat
functions.description: Ask the CISO Copilot a natural-language compliance question grounded in live GRC data.

message.description: User question in Ukrainian or English.

functions.name: copilotStatus
functions.description: Return whether Azure OpenAI (Microsoft Copilot stack) is configured for the in-app agent.
